messages:
elaine-marketing: Quick sync — we need to iterate the competitive messaging for next week's benchmark webinar. Primary opponents: cloud AI platforms, LLM API vendors, and infra-only stacks. Need one-pagers and 3 battlecard soundbites per persona. Who can own?

sam-sales: I can take the cloud AI one. Need crisp objection-handling lines vs price + lock-in.

vivian-growth: I'll do webinar landing copy + CTA tests. Can we get top 3 bench numbers to justify claims?

todd-product: We should be careful with numeric claims. Use our latency p50/p95 and per-token $ estimates vs named competitors. I have a draft table — will share.

nate-research: I'll pull verified numbers from the last sprint: hosted p95 = 210ms, per-token unit ~$0.0008; competitor A (cloudX) p95=340ms / ~$0.0012; competitor B (APIHub) p95=290ms / ~$0.0010. Notes attached (internal).

elaine-marketing: Love it. @legal-bot do we need a citation disclaimer? :eyes:

legal-bot: Quick note: All competitor numbers need source attribution. Avoid absolute superlatives without context. Suggested phrasing: "lower unit cost on typical LLM workloads (based on internal benchmark suite)."

sam-sales: For objection handling vs cloudX — "predictable latency at scale" + "no surprise egress fees" — keep short. Any one-liner suggestions?

vivian-growth: A/B variant A: "Ship LLM features with predictable latency and lower unit cost." Variant B: "Scale inference without lock-in — same dev experience across hosted, dedicated, and private." Will run 2:1 for first 48h.

todd-product: Battlecard bullets per persona:
- Platform engineer: routing/fallback, private deployment, KMS/HSM.
- ML engineer: quantization recommendations, runtime kernel selection, KV caching.
- Product lead: cost levers, SLAs, rollout controls.

nate-research: Also add: "automated fallbacks and regional routing keep apps online during partial outages" — we have supporting test logs.

elaine-marketing: Timeline: draft battlecards by EOD Thursday, landing + webinar copy by Monday, webinar Wed. Owners: sam (cloud), todd (infra vendors), nate (LLM API vendors). vivian runs landing.

sam-sales: I'll whip a 2-slide quick deck for SDRs with 3 soundbites and 2 pushbacks.

vivian-growth: For inbound routing — propose tagging leads from webinar as "bench-webinar-03" and route to SDR queue A for enterprise interested, queue B for trial signups. Anyone object?

todd-product: Fine. Add a follow-up nurture for those who engage but don't convert — 7-day benchmark recap + invite to run a free test.

elaine-marketing: Also need a short internal script for field to handle "we already use cloudX" — include demo invite + cost snapshot.

sam-sales: Draft script: "We respect cloudX for model access. If your bottleneck is predictable latency/cost, we'd love to show a short cost & latency demo." Thoughts?

nate-research: Maybe avoid time promises like "10-minute" — legal flagged time claims. Use "short demo" instead.

vivian-growth: Two webinar CTAs: 1) "Run a free benchmark" 2) "Schedule a demo" — we'll A/B which converts.

elaine-marketing: Quick poll — who can review battlecard copy by Wednesday noon? React below.

sam-sales: :thumbsup:

vivian-growth: :thumbsup:

nate-research: :thumbsup:

legal-bot: Left one comment in the draft doc about attribution language.

vivian-growth: For lead tagging rule please use this exact format so ops can auto-route:
```
source:webinar; campaign:bench-mar2026; tag:bench-webinar-03
```

elaine-marketing: Perfect. I'll consolidate and send updated drafts by EOD. Thanks all. :rocket:
